title: Every four-dimensional Kakeya set has full Hausdorff dimension
summary: We prove the four-dimensional Hausdorff-dimension Kakeya conjecture: every subset of ℝ 4 containing a unit line segment in every direction has Hausdorff dimension four. No compactness or regularity assumption is imposed on the set or its witnessing line family.
family_title: Kakeya in three and four dimensions

review.reason: Proves the four-dimensional Kakeya conjecture on Hausdorff dimension of line-containing sets.
